'''Liu Fang''' is a female Huanglong NPC visiting Septimont in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. She is on a quest to visit every wishing fountain and it's implied she already visited 12 cities. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:;'''Liu Fang''' I think I did it the right way. Fingers crossed...
:;Huh? Is that tourist trying to make a wish at the fountain? Should I tell her that's not a thing we do here...?
:;Nah... Let the tourists have their fun.

:'''Liu Fang''' Hello, have you come to make a wish too?
:{{DIcon}} You can make wishes here?
:'''Liu Fang''' Of course, a [[Buling|Taoist monk]] told me Septimont's wishing well can really work miracles. She even taught me the right way to do it.
:'''Liu Fang''' I've been to many wishing wells, so I know that each place has its own wishing customs. Which is why if you don't follow the proper procedures, your wish won't come true!
----
;(Night at [[Leondis Hotel]])
:;'''Liu Fang''' I'll head home once I've visited every wishing well I can find. Until then, I'll just have to have my little brother look after Mom.
:;'''Liu Fang''' Septimont makes it No. 12. You will get better, Mom.	
{{Dialogue End}}
